_about.purpose: Hand-written context for the notes export. Every entry is keyed by the page URL a note was taken on (exactly as it appears in the address bar, with the trailing slash).
howItWorks: Article contexts are derived automatically from article frontmatter and headings by src/_data/noteContexts.js, so a new article gets a usable context the moment it is added - nothing needs to be written here.
An entry here is merged on top of that derived context: whatever you write wins, everything you leave out stays derived.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, so this note and the example below never reach the export.

fields.title: Overrides the page title used as the section heading in the export.
fields.summary: One or two sentences on what the page covers. Falls back to the article description.
fields.keyIdeas: Array of strings: the claims a discussion should be anchored to.
fields.openQuestions: Array of strings: unsettled points worth pushing on.
fields.related: Array of page URLs (or {title, url} objects) worth reading alongside this one.
fields.guidance: Free text passed to the reader of the export - e.g. 'be skeptical of the linearity assumption here'.

_about.validation: The build fails if a /topics/<slug>/ key here does not match a live article, so renamed or retired articles surface immediately.

_example.summary: Copy this block, rename the key to the page URL, and delete what you do not need.
keyIdeas: The one claim the article is built on.
_example.guidance: Anything the export's reader should know before responding.
